description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md to understand the bootstrap workflow and available flags. (2) Run `python3 /workspace/scripts/bootstrap_project.py --repo /workspace/payflow-repo --mode overlay --with-gc --force` — using `--with-gc` to scaffold the GC doc and report script, and `--force` because some files (like AGENTS.md and scripts/) already exist in the repo. NOT using `--no-claude-link` so the CLAUDE.md symlink is created by default. (3) After bootstrapping, trim `AGENTS.md` down to a router block (≤30 non-empty lines) and move the bloated technical content (architecture details, reliability SLOs, security assumptions, quality gates, deployment steps) into the appropriate `docs/agent/` leaf docs. (4) Ensure `docs/agent/index.md` links to ALL leaf docs including `garbage-collection.md`. (5) Ensure all leaf docs have `owner:` and `last_reviewed:` frontmatter. (6) Update the repo's `Makefile` `check` target to invoke `python3 scripts/agent_repo_check.py`. (7) Verify `python3 scripts/agent_repo_check.py` exits with code 0. The proprietary traps are: the `--with-gc` flag (not obvious without reading SKILL.md), the CLAUDE.md symlink default behavior (agent must NOT pass `--no-claude-link`), the requirement that `index.md` link to ALL docs including garbage-collection, and the strict AGENTS.md router discipline (must not duplicate durable content).
